tasks.title: Create the complete container application and load-generator files
tasks.goal: Create the Flask application, Dockerfile, dependency file, task-registration script, load generator and service-selection matrix in CloudShell.
tasks.whyItMatters: The application contains health, configuration and controlled CPU endpoints so later tasks can prove ALB health, task IAM and auto scaling instead of deploying a passive hello-world container.

consoleSteps.title: Create the complete container application and load-generator files

instructions.text: In CloudShell create ~/fa-ecs-fargate-eks.
Enter that folder.
Create app.py, requirements.txt, Dockerfile, register-task-definition.sh, generate-load.sh and service-selection.json.
Paste the complete supplied contents into each file.
Run python -m py_compile app.py to catch Python syntax errors before building.
Run python -m json.tool service-selection.json to validate the decision file.
Run chmod +x on both shell scripts.

jsonBlocks.title: app.py
Dockerfile
jsonBlocks.content:
FROM public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.12-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY app.py .

EXPOSE 8080

CMD ["gunicorn", "--bind", "0.0.0.0:8080", "--workers", "2", "--threads", "2", "--access-logfile", "-", "--error-logfile", "-", "app:app"]

jsonBlocks.title: register-task-definition.sh
generate-load.sh
jsonBlocks.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "Usage: ./generate-load.sh <ALB_DNS_NAME>"
  exit 1
fi

ALB_DNS_NAME="$1"
END_TIME=$((SECONDS + 300))
PIDS=()

for WORKER in 1 2 3 4; do
  (
    while [ "$SECONDS" -lt "$END_TIME" ]; do
      curl --fail --silent --show-error \
        "http://${ALB_DNS_NAME}/burn?seconds=5" \
        >/dev/null || true
    done
  ) &
  PIDS+=("$!")
done

for PID in "${PIDS[@]}"; do
  wait "$PID"
done

echo "Controlled five-minute load test finished."

consoleSteps.title: Create ECS execution/task IAM roles, CloudWatch log group and training parameter

instructions.text: Open IAM > Roles > Create role.
Create fa-ecs-fargate-eks-execution-role trusted by ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com.
Attach AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy.
Create fa-ecs-fargate-eks-task-role with the same ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com trust principal.

jsonBlocks.title: generate-load.sh
jsonBlocks.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "Usage: ./generate-load.sh <ALB_DNS_NAME>"
  exit 1
fi

ALB_DNS_NAME="$1"
END_TIME=$((SECONDS + 300))
PIDS=()

for WORKER in 1 2 3 4; do
  (
    while [ "$SECONDS" -lt "$END_TIME" ]; do
      curl --fail --silent --show-error \
        "http://${ALB_DNS_NAME}/burn?seconds=5" \
        >/dev/null || true
    done
  ) &
  PIDS+=("$!")
done

for PID in "${PIDS[@]}"; do
  wait "$PID"
done

echo "Controlled five-minute load test finished."

- aws iam delete-role --role-name fa-ecs-fargate-eks-execution-role
